channel.title: Za on SA Local Info
channel.description: Recent content in Za on SA Local Info

item.title: Petrol and Diesel Expected to Drop on 2 December 2026
item.description: CEF data to 24 November points to a petrol cut of R3.71 to R3.93 a litre and a diesel cut of R1.93 to R2.38 from Wednesday, 2 December 2026.

item.title: SASSA Older Persons Grant 2026: R2,400 Amount, Payment Dates and eLife
item.description: The SASSA Older Persons Grant is R2,400 a month (R2,420 if you are 75 or older) from April 2026. Payment dates, the 2026 means test, eLife certification and how to apply.

item.title: Diesel Price Forecast June 2026: CEF Data Signals a Decrease
item.description: The CEF daily basic fuel price shows an over-recovery of 78 c/l for diesel as Brent crude drops from $126 to $101. Here is what June 2026 could look like.

item.title: Petrol Price Increase June 2026: Why South Africans Pay More
item.description: Petrol prices are rising in June 2026 as fuel levy relief is halved and global crude oil prices stay high. Here is what is happening and why.

item.title: SASSA SRD Grant June 2026: Still R370, Extended to March 2027
item.description: The SRD grant stays at R370 for June 2026 — no increase from the 2026 Budget, but extended to March 2027. Payment dates, eligibility, and how to check your status.

item.title: Petrol Price Increase South Africa: Huge April 2026 Hikes Expected
item.description: Latest forecast for the South Africa petrol price increase in April 2026. Detailed tables for inland and coastal prices, including new fuel tax changes.

item.title: Petrol Price Forecast for South Africa
item.description: Daily petrol price forecast for South Africa.

item.title: How to Get Your SRD R370 Grant Paid in 2026: Bank, Cash Send or Postbank
item.description: The ways your SRD R370 grant can be paid in 2026: your own bank account, a cash send code you withdraw at an ATM, or a Postbank card. How to change your details safely.

item.title: SASSA Grant Requirements 2026/27: Eligibility and Amounts for Every Grant
item.description: Every SASSA grant for 2026/27 in one place: the new amounts from April 2026, who qualifies, the means test and the documents you need to apply.

item.title: How to Renew Your Driving Licence Card in 2026: Book Online, Then Visit the DLTC
item.description: Renewing your driving licence card in 2026: book a slot online on NaTIS, what to take to the testing centre, how long the new card takes and what happens if your card expires.

item.title: How to Check and Pay Cape Town Traffic Fines in 2026
item.description: Check your City of Cape Town traffic fines online and pay them with PayThat, your banking app, at Checkers, Pick n Pay and other stores, or at a City office. What happens if you don’t pay.

item.title: How to Renew Your Licence Disc Online in 2026: Options and Fees
item.description: Renew your vehicle licence disc online through NaTIS, your bank app, Pick n Pay or the Post Office. What you need, what it costs and the 21-day grace period.

item.title: SRD Grant Appeal 2026: How to Appeal a Declined R370 (R350) Grant
item.description: Was your SRD R370 grant declined? How to lodge an appeal online with the Independent Tribunal, the 90-day deadline, how to check your appeal status and what happens next.

item.title: SRD Status Check 2026: How to Check Your R370 Grant and Payment Date
item.description: Check your SASSA SRD R370 status online in a few minutes. What each status means, how to find your payment date and what to do if you were declined.
